post.description: Deletes the accounts, categories, transactions and transfers of the user and the user, at once and for good. The access token keeps working until it expires but finds nothing, and the refresh token is refused. Afterwards the client drops both tokens and logs out at the identity provider (`POST /api/auth/logout`, then the browser goes to `endSessionUrl`); otherwise the next login signs in again without a password. The identity at the provider stays: logging in again creates a new, empty user.
